name: ci-diagnosis
description: CI failure diagnosis tasks targeting the-operator member

tasks.input: Diagnose: the deploy job fails with 'permission denied' when pushing the Docker image to the registry. The token worked last week.
tasks.expectedOutput: A diagnosis that checks the registry token expiry, rotation, and scopes, and suggests re-issuing the token or pinning it to the registry.

tasks.input: Diagnose: the test job passes locally but fails in CI with the same seed. The failure is in a date-based test.
tasks.expectedOutput: A diagnosis that points at timezone or clock differences between the local machine and the CI runner, and suggests fixing the test to use explicit timestamps instead of now().

tasks.input: Diagnose: the CI pipeline is stuck in a queued state and no runner picks up the job after an infrastructure migration.
tasks.expectedOutput: A diagnosis that verifies runner registration, connectivity, and labels after the migration, and proposes re-registering runners or re-pointing the pipeline to the new runner pool.
